description: Implementation of buffer-to-texture and texture-to-buffer copy operations for Direct3D 11 in the ANGLE project, including resource loading, shader management, and copy parameter setup.

classes.name: PixelTransfer11
classes.description: Handles buffer-to-texture and texture-to-buffer pixel transfer operations using Direct3D 11 in ANGLE.

methods.name: loadResources
methods.description: Loads necessary GPU resources such as shaders and states for pixel transfer operations.

methods.name: setBufferToTextureCopyParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for copying buffer data to a texture, including offsets and scaling.

methods.name: copyBufferToTexture
methods.description: Performs the copy operation from a buffer to a texture using GPU shaders.

methods.name: buildShaderMap
methods.description: Builds a map of shaders for different internal formats used in buffer-to-texture copying.

methods.name: findBufferToTexturePS
methods.description: Finds the appropriate pixel shader for a given internal format.
